budgetEnforcement: Test-driver main fetch gate. Original global cap USD 0.25; prior reserved USD 0.057565801; this series cap USD 0.19243419, split equally among five. Counts every HTTP retry, max12/attempt, exact Responses endpoint, redirects denied, before-request reservation of request UTF-8 bytes+4096 framing tokens and max_output_tokens4096. This is a conservative Standard-price estimate, not provider billing enforcement. Exclusive execution ledger prohibits a third series.
timeoutEnforcement: Main fetch abort deadline 180000 ms per attempt, production transport total timeout120000 ms per request and bounded command runner. Cleanup closes the owned app; no separate connection-test request.

attempts.scenario: Independent synthetic sum repair through packaged GUI, permission and intended verification/return; first attempt reloads pending permission.
attempts.safeReason: Driver supplied nvm alias executable instead of backend canonical trusted Node path. Command succeeded but persisted verification remained unverified: Command is not a trusted project verification check. Diff and safe return were not reached. streamBeforeCompletion=false means not observed by polling, not proof of absent streaming. permissionReload=false on attempts 2-5 means not exercised.
